ORDINANCE NoN 1,2023

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:
SECTION 1. Title 17, of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance be amended by changing all the RS3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached
House) District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 11-L in the area

bounded by

West Cullom Avenue; North Laramie Avenue; the alley next south of
and parallel to West Cullom Avenue; and a line 39.67 feet west of and
parallel to North Laramie Avenue,

to those of a RT4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage

and due publication.

Common address of properties: 5201 West Cullom Avenue
